name: Let's Try Again Spokane 2022

venue.name: Spokane First Church of the Nazarene
venue.address: 9004 N COUNTRY HOMES BLVD SPOKANE, WA 99218
venue.details: We will be in the gymnasium (Family Life Center)

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LetsTryAgainSpokane2022#16931-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out the [PNW website](https://www.pnwcubing.com)!

Please be aware of Covid-19 precautions and read [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LetsTryAgainSpokane2022#16930-covid-19-safety) before registering.
